noharm.problem: A recovery-support app stores deeply private data and runs a public API that has to withstand abuse.
noharm.decision: FastAPI on Clean Architecture, AES-256 field-level encryption, JWT rotation with a token blacklist, Socket.IO chat and three-layer rate limiting on Redis with atomic Lua scripts.
noharm.result: Live at noharm.site, with the backend on AWS (ECS, RDS) provisioned by Terraform and Android/iOS builds via Capacitor.

maindug.problem: Most password managers lock you into someone else's vault.
maindug.decision: A self-hostable Flask + PostgreSQL webservice plus a browser extension that captures logins and offers autocomplete, with Argon2 hashing and reused/leaked password detection.
maindug.result: My IFPR final-year project, documented in LaTeX with a threat model and covered by pytest and GitHub Actions CI.

pitest.problem: Bench operators need to validate Raspberry Pi boards before delivery or after a repair, without a keyboard or SSH.
pitest.decision: A systemd service that runs on every boot: 7 checks (LAN, Wi-Fi, boot, USB, GPIO, Bluetooth, hotspot) while the screen shows progress and test patterns.
pitest.result: Results go to a Flask + PostgreSQL dashboard that keeps each board's history by MAC address; the operator confirms screen and LEDs on the site.

desc.reportgen: Technical report builder: React front, Express + Puppeteer rendering PDFs on the server. Exports to PDF, DOCX and JSON.
desc.iptool: Geographic IP lookup with interactive map, IPv4/IPv6 validation and detailed network data.
desc.customThread: Extends threading.Thread with return values, exception propagation and callbacks. Zero dependencies, on PyPI.
desc.ddgame: D&D-themed clicker in React and TypeScript: roll the dice for XP and spend it in the upgrade shop. Deployed on Vercel.
desc.maze: Maze generator and pathfinding visualizer rewritten in React 19. Compare DFS and BFS on the same maze.
desc.geoknocker: Desktop tool for port scanning and IP geolocation with concurrent scanning via threading.
desc.hashTable: Hash table in C with chaining and automatic rehashing at 75% load factor.
desc.venetia: D&D 5.5 character creator with a 13-step wizard, 333 Vitest tests and 108 Playwright runs. Android via Capacitor.
desc.phishing: Typosquatting heuristics plus Google Safe Browsing, VirusTotal and URLhaus verdicts.
desc.talentScout: Classifies athletes into tiers with a K-Nearest Neighbors model: PCA, correlation matrix, radar charts.
